# Projects

66 repositories in the five layers, plus the curated lists this one was built from. Stars are as displayed on GitHub on the date given and are context, not a quality score. License and last commit come from a shallow clone on the check date. **Evidence** is the highest rung of the [evidence ladder](../02-evidence-ladder.md) a third party can inspect for the project's headline performance claim (`bench` = it evaluates other systems; `n/a` = infrastructure or no performance claim). **Repro** says whether the headline numbers can be regenerated from the repo.
